body_edits.diff: - [X] Please search the issues in case your question has been discussed before. - [X] Make sure you are looking at the latest edits at: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/tree/master/4.0 As stated in the title of this issue - hyper-links in the PDF that include a fragment are broken, since the fragment is rendered as %23.
